scheme_name: Safai Karmakar Ke Bachche Hetu Chhatravrtti Yojana
other_conditions: Only two sons or daughters of registered sanitation workers are eligible for the scholarship
The student must be admitted to a college, polytechnic, engineering, medical or other professional course and study for a minimum of one year
If the student is eligible for a scholarship under any other government scheme, they may choose only one scheme
The student cannot receive benefits from two schemes simultaneously
benefits_summary: Provides an annual scholarship ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹15,000 depending on the education level and gender of the student.
